content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Ashley Roberts (E016) requests write access to Payroll.

There are two notes with conflicting information:
- Note 1 (HR): full_time Analyst, recommend write.
- Note 2 (Security): contractor with basic security training, recommend read. Security says it's authoritative for employment type/training.

Access policy:
- full_time: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
- contractor: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role. Ashley is Analyst, so not owner.

If contractor with basic security training: max is read. Requested write > max, so grant read.

Which note to trust? Security DB is authoritative for employment type/training per Note 2. So contractor, basic training → max read → grant read.

Let me submit decision: read.
